compiled_state.title: Add distinct(page) > 1 detection to story-decomposer and attach coordination-pass task on multi-page epics
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1 (c5ef): when the Copy Needs section contains items on 2 or more distinct page values, /dso:preplanning attaches a coordination-pass task to the copy story
- dd-2 (c5ef): with only 1 distinct page value, no coordination-pass task is attached

## Description
Extend plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md so that when the auto-created copy story (from story 0868) is being drafted on a copy-needed epic, the agent parses the epic's ## Copy Needs section and counts distinct values of the `page` field across items. When distinct(page) > 1, append a child coordination-pass task to the copy story with a description that documents the second-pass dispatch contract (input = first-pass rationale; output = mutated artifact with hard-constraint items unchanged).

When distinct(page) == 1, no coordination-pass task is attached.

Page count source: Copy Needs section in the epic description (NOT the artifact, which doesn't exist at preplanning time).

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a copy-needed epic with Copy Needs items spanning 2+ distinct page values; When story-decomposer runs; Then the auto-created copy story has a coordination-pass child task. Given a copy-needed epic with all items on one page; When story-decomposer runs; Then no coordination-pass task is attached.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] story-decomposer documents coordination-pass attachment logic
  Verify: grep -qE 'coordination-pass|distinct.*page' plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md
- [ ] Behavioral test: multi-page case attaches coordination-pass
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-coordination-pass-attach.sh test_multi_page
- [ ] Behavioral test: single-page case does NOT attach
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-coordination-pass-attach.sh test_single_page
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-coordination-pass-attach.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index
